args.question:
Cobalt Labs has two approved invoices, so I need to know which one you mean (the instruction said "the approved invoice," singular):
• INV-15523 — $7,693.96, due 2026-11-25
• INV-89190 — $3,526.06, due 2026-11-04

(Their invoice INV-28385 for $7,523.69 is still in draft/awaiting approval and INV-26154 is already paid, so those are excluded.)

Which invoice should I pay by wire from the operating account? Or do you want both approved invoices paid?
